examined_formations.title: UK_BICS_MANUFACTURING_ELECTRICITY_RELIEF_APPLICATION
examined_formations.chinese_title: 英国BICS制造业电费减免申请
examined_formations.recent_change: BICS applicant guidance was first published in August 2026 and the first application window opens 1 October 2026.
examined_formations.monetary_value: Eligible manufacturing sites can receive material electricity-cost exemptions; current market coverage describes savings of up to roughly 25% for qualifying businesses.
examined_formations.operator_accessibility: Government guidance explicitly permits a consultant or other third party to submit with Companies House officer authorization; evidence is document and meter-data based.

examined_formations.title: US_SECTION_45F_EMPLOYER_CHILDCARE_CREDIT_CAPTURE
examined_formations.chinese_title: 美国Section 45F雇主托育税收抵免获取
examined_formations.recent_change: For tax year 2026 the federal employer-provided child care credit was materially expanded, including higher rates and annual caps.
examined_formations.monetary_value: Published federal cap rises to $500,000 and $600,000 for eligible small businesses.
examined_formations.operator_accessibility: Employer expense and contract records can be assembled and Form 8882 is the claim rail.

examined_formations.title: UK_SFI26_FARM_LAND_MANAGEMENT_PAYMENTS
examined_formations.chinese_title: 英国SFI26农场土地管理补贴申请
examined_formations.recent_change: SFI26 opened new 2026 application windows and allows up to £100,000 agreement value per farm business per year.
examined_formations.monetary_value: Potential multi-year farm payments are material.
examined_formations.operator_accessibility: RPA explicitly supports authorized agents acting for a farm business.

examined_formations.title: AUSTRALIA_PRF_SAFEGUARD_TRANSFORMATION_STREAM_R2
examined_formations.chinese_title: 澳大利亚PRF减排转型基金第二轮申请
examined_formations.recent_change: Round 2 opened in February 2026 and remains open in assessment batches through May 2027.
examined_formations.monetary_value: Grants range from AUD 500,000 to AUD 50,000,000 and may cover up to 50% of eligible project expenditure.
examined_formations.operator_accessibility: Applicant documents and portal submission are accessible, but applications require project, engineering, financial and merit evidence.

examined_formations.title: KOREA_H1_2026_NEW_MERCHANT_CARD_FEE_REFUND
examined_formations.chinese_title: 韩国2026上半年新商户银行卡手续费返还
examined_formations.recent_change: In August 2026 the FSC announced retroactive preferential fee treatment for newly opened small and medium merchants.
examined_formations.monetary_value: About KRW 61.47 billion is expected to be refunded across roughly 159,000 merchants, averaging about KRW 387,000.
examined_formations.operator_accessibility: Merchant/account data exists, but no claim filing is required.

examined_formations.title: BUSAN_2026_SMALL_BUSINESS_ENERGY_VOUCHER
examined_formations.chinese_title: 釜山2026小商户能源代金券
examined_formations.recent_change: Busan announced a September-November 2026 energy-voucher application window for eligible small businesses.
examined_formations.monetary_value: KRW 200,000 per eligible business in Dongbaekjeon points.
examined_formations.operator_accessibility: Eligibility is rule-based and application is directly available in the Dongbaekjeon app, with an official support desk for users who cannot use the app.
